Justice

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1674053212573{background-color: #ffffff !important;}”][vc_column width=”3/4″][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1759250542199{margin-right: 30px !important;}”]The judicial system of the Principality of Sabourg is administered by the Directorate of Judicial Affairs under the supervision of the Minister of Justice and divided into four courts:

  • Court of First Instance (civil and criminal)
  • Court of Appeal (civil and criminal)
  • Supreme Court
  • Constitutional Court

In accordance with Article 80 of the Constitution, the Constitutional Court is composed of three permanent members and two alternates appointed by the Prince-Abbot.

L’Ordinanza Sovrana n° OS1SE05-280925 sancisce la nomina del Presidente della Corte Suprema nella persona del Prof. Vincenzo Zagari.

L’Ordinanza Sovrana n° OS1SE02-280925 sancisce la nomina del Vice Presidente della Corte Costituzionale nella persona di S.E.Rev.ma Mons. Marc Vincent Vattier.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][/vc_row]
